This page lists 176 DataGrip keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `datagrip.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in DataGrip to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t datagrip.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/datagrip.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/DataGrip.app`; if DataGrip lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Essentials

⇧⇧ and ⌃⌃ mean double-tap the key.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⇧` | Search Everywhere |
| `⌘⇧A` | Find Action |
| `⌃⌃` | Run Anything |
| `⌘E` | Recent Files |
| `⌥⏎` | Show Intention Actions |
| `⌥F1` | Select In... |
| `⌘,` | Settings |
| `⌘N` | Generate... |
| `⌃V` | VCS Operations Popup |
| `⌃T` | Refactor This |
| `⌘⌥L` | Reformat Code |
